translations.web: Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
translations.bsb: Unequal weights are detestable to the LORD, and dishonest scales are no good.
translations.kjv: Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD; and a false balance is not good.
translations.asv: Diverse weights are an abomination to Jehovah; And a false balance is not good.
